subject: english
title: 關係子句

codes.text: 國中階段所學的文法句型（附錄六「國民中學英語文基礎文法句構參考表」：關係子句：關係代名詞 who/which/that/whose）

intro: 關係子句用來補充說明前面的名詞（先行詞）。這單元要會選 who、which、that、whose，知道什麼時候可以省略關代，並注意子句裡動詞的單複數。會考常以填空與改寫句子出題。

sections.title: who / which / that 的選用
points: 關代的選用看**先行詞**：人用 **who**，事物或動物用 **which**，兩者都可用 **that**。
例：The girl **who** is standing there is my sister.（站在那裡的女孩是我妹妹。）
例：I have a dog **which** likes to swim.（我有一隻喜歡游泳的狗。）
例：This is the book **that** I bought yesterday.（這是我昨天買的書。）
先行詞含 the only、the first、all、everything 等限定詞時，通常用 **that**。例：He is the only student **that** can solve it.（他是唯一能解開這題的學生。）

sections.title: 關代當主詞與當受詞
points: 關代當**主詞**：後面直接接動詞。例：The boy **who** lives next door is Jack.（住在隔壁的男孩是 Jack。）
關代當**受詞**：後面是「主詞 + 動詞」。例：The movie **which** I saw last night was great.（我昨晚看的電影很棒。）
受詞關代可以**省略**：The movie I saw last night was great.，但**主詞關代不能省略**。
常錯：不要把關代後面又重複代名詞。The movie which I saw **it**（錯）→ The movie which I saw（對）。

sections.title: whose 與動詞一致
points: **whose** 表示「……的」，後面接名詞：I have a friend **whose** father is a doctor.（我有個朋友，他的爸爸是醫生。）
whose 不能換成 who 或 which：不能寫 a friend who father is a doctor。
關代子句裡的動詞要和**先行詞**一致：The boys who **are** playing basketball are my classmates.（正在打籃球的男孩是我同學。）
The girl who **sings** well is Amy.（唱得好的女孩是 Amy。）先行詞單數，動詞加 s。

sections.title: 限制與補充說明、改寫句子
points: 關代前有逗號是補充說明，這時**不能用 that**。例：My uncle, **who** lives in Kaohsiung, is a pilot.（我叔叔住在高雄，是飛行員。）
合併兩句：I know a boy. He plays the violin. → I know a boy **who** plays the violin.（我認識一個會拉小提琴的男孩。）
改寫時，被取代的代名詞（he, it, they）要刪掉。
his / her / their 這類所有格被取代時，用 whose：The man's car is red. → The man **whose** car is red ...

mustKnow.name: 人用 who
mustKnow.body: The girl who sings is Amy.

mustKnow.name: 物用 which
mustKnow.body: The book which is on the desk is mine.

mustKnow.name: that
mustKnow.body: 人或物都可用；the only、all、everything 後常用 that

mustKnow.name: 可省略的關代
mustKnow.body: 只有當受詞的關代可省略，當主詞的不行

mustKnow.name: 不重複代名詞
mustKnow.body: The movie I saw（不寫 I saw it）

quiz.q: The girl _____ is standing there is my sister.
quiz.explain: 先行詞 The girl 是人，後面缺主詞，用關代 who。which 用於事物；what 不能接在先行詞後面；where 是關係副詞，指地點。答案是 who

quiz.q: The cake _____ is on the table is mine.
quiz.explain: 先行詞 the cake 是物，關代當主詞，用 which。who 用於人；whose 後面要接名詞；where 表示地點。答案是 which

quiz.q: This is the book _____ I bought yesterday.
quiz.explain: 先行詞 the book 是事物，關代當 bought 的受詞，可用 that。who 指人；whose 後面要接名詞；where 指地點，後面不能接「I bought」。答案是 that

quiz.q: I have a friend _____ father is a doctor.
quiz.explain: 空格後面是名詞 father，表示「朋友的爸爸」，要用所有格關代 whose。who、whom 後面不能直接接名詞表示所有；which 指事物。答案是 whose

choices: The movie I saw it last night was great.
The movie I saw last night was great.
The movie saw I last night was great.
The movie which I saw it last night was great.
quiz.explain: The movie I saw last night 省略了當受詞的 which / that，是正確的。另一句多了 it，會使 saw 有兩個受詞；saw I 的語序錯誤；which 之後再加 it，也是受詞重複。答案是 The movie I saw last night was great.

quiz.q: He is the only student _____ can solve the problem.
quiz.explain: 先行詞前有 the only，關代通常用 that，這裡當 can solve 的主詞。which 用於事物；whose 後面要接名詞；whom 是受格，不能當主詞。答案是 that

quiz.q: My uncle, _____ lives in Kaohsiung, is a pilot.
quiz.explain: My uncle 是人，前面有逗號，是補充說明，用 who。逗號之後不能用 that；which 不能指人；whose 後面要接名詞。答案是 who

quiz.q: The boys who _____ playing basketball over there are my classmates.
quiz.explain: 先行詞 The boys 是複數，關代子句的 be 動詞用 are（現在進行式 are playing）。is 用於單數；am 只配 I；be 不能直接當動詞。答案是 are
